shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/obelisk/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '*Tooltip*' -g '*.test.*' -g '*.spec.*' | head -200 && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "wc -l .agents/skills/obelisk/SKILL.md && sed -n '241,520p' .agents/skills/obelisk/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- source candidates ---\\n' && rg -n \"delayShow|activeAnchor|mouseout|focusout|relatedTarget|isVisible|showTooltip|hideTooltip\" src/components src/test"

/bin/bash -lc 'git log --oneline --all -- src/components/Tooltip/use-tooltip-events.tsx src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx | head -30 && git blame -L 290,370 -- src/components/Tooltip/use-tooltip-events.tsx && git blame -L 270,300 -- src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc 'git show --stat --oneline e730508 && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff e730508 -- src/components/Tooltip/use-tooltip-events.tsx src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx src/test'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"function debounce|const debounce|export.*debounce\" src && sed -n '1,180p' src/utils/debounce.ts 2>/dev/null || true && rg -n \"debounce\" src/utils* src -g '*.ts' -g '*.tsx' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/test/tooltip-imperative.spec.js | sed -n '135,185p'; rg -n \"imperative-zero|isOpen\" src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx src/components/TooltipController/TooltipController.tsx | head -40; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx | sed -n '115,215p'; nl -ba src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx | sed -n '580,650p'; nl -ba src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx | sed -n '410,470p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && npx jest src/test/tooltip-anchor-selection.spec.js src/test/tooltip-close-and-delay-behavior.spec.js --runInBand && npx tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx jest --runInBand --testPathIgnorePatterns=src/test/tooltip-imperative.spec.js && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'
